notes: Only a thin result. I read search-result snippets only and did not open the 10-Qs or the call transcripts. None of the four labs breaks out MRD test volume or revenue in the Q2'26 materials I saw. Exact Sciences appears to have no Q2'26 release; the search suggested an Abbott acquisition, which I did not verify. Myriad's Precise MRD is still pre-commercial, with full launch in 2027. Quest and Labcorp mention Haystack and Plasma Detect only qualitatively. The Myriad item is the only new datapoint, and it is weak evidence for 1C. Myriad's -1% volume is already in the known list. This outcome is mild support for the thesis: non-Natera MRD is not yet a visible volume driver for Illumina.
how_to_mine: Open the full Myriad Q2'26 call transcript (myriad.gcs-web.com/node/27491/html) and search for 'Precise MRD' to check for volume, sequencer and cost remarks. Open the Quest Q2'26 call transcript (sahmcapital.com link) and the Quest 8-K Ex 99.1 (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001022079/000102207926000067/dgx063020268-kex991.htm) for any Haystack volume. Open the Labcorp Q2'26 10-Q for the oncology or Plasma Detect volume line. Confirm Exact's status: if Abbott closed the deal there is no Q2'26 10-Q, so use Exact's Q1'26 or Q4'25 Oncodetect commentary, or Abbott's call.

items.label: 1C
items.claim: Myriad's Precise MRD is still pre-commercial, with full launch not until 2027, so it adds no MRD volume to Illumina in 2026.
items.detail: Myriad's Q2'26 release (30 Jul 2026) says it remains on track for a full commercial launch of Precise MRD in 2027. Adoption is described only qualitatively (growing clinicians and sites, some repeat orders), with no test counts. Total Myriad revenue was $190.7M (-11% y/y), driven by volume -1% and average revenue per test -9%. A non-Natera MRD entrant is therefore not a 2026 volume lever.
items.quote: remains on track for a full commercial launch of Precise MRD in 2027
items.why_new: The known list has Myriad's -1% volume but not the Precise MRD 2027 full-launch timing or the -9% revenue per test.

items.label: 1C
items.claim: Quest cites New York approval of Haystack MRD as an oncology tailwind but gives no MRD volume, so MRD is not yet a reported mix driver.
items.detail: Quest's Q2'26 release and call (23 Jul 2026) describe oncology growth tied partly to New York State approval of Haystack MRD, alongside brain health and cardiometabolic tests. Quest's DIS requisition volume grew +13.1%, but no Haystack test count or revenue was found in the snippets. This is a search-result summary only, not the filing text.
items.why_new: The known list has the Quest and Labcorp Ultima MRD collaborations but not the Q2'26 Haystack status.
